About

Home > About

Tonic is the Contextualized SecurityTM
Company. 

We are reshaping Exposure Management by providing security teams with the context they need to prioritize and remediate vulnerabilities and threats. Make quicker and smarter decisions with meaningful and actionable context at your fingertips, powered by Tonic’s AI Data Fabric.

Vision

A world where security teams outpace attackers, preempt threats, and resolve real risk. 

Mission

Be the operating layer for continuous exposure reduction – enabling precise prioritization and decisive execution.
